name: faana-community-tools
description: Claude as your video director, editor and publisher: plan and shoot talking-head videos on your phone, turn the footage into captioned shorts, and publish with your approval.

plugins.name: video-director
plugins.description: Your video director and producer, so you only have to act: ideas and labelled scripts from your own material, shot lists and call sheets for your real location and gear, on-set coaching with film and broadcast craft adapted for a phone, and dailies review of your takes.

plugins.name: video-production
plugins.description: Turn raw talking-head recordings into a themed series of captioned short videos and a longer cut, with audio cleanup, theme discovery with the speaker, stabilised framing and a QA battery. Runs locally in Claude Code.

plugins.name: social-publishing
plugins.description: Publish or schedule posts and videos to LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok and Facebook through Zernio, with a user-approved preview enforced before anything goes out.
